title: Medicaid Managed Care Membership Eligibility Category Entry Gates
content:
Each eligibility category of the Medicaid Managed Care Membership admits a person only through its own entry gate. The gate is read on the coverage start date: age is counted in completed years on that date, and household income is the whole percent of the federal poverty level printed on the state enrollment file. The schedule below states every category's gate figures.

## Schedule of entry gates

| Category | Age in completed years | Income floor (% FPL) | Income limit (% FPL) | Medicare Part A and B entitlement a condition | SSI or state disability determination (or age 65 or older) a condition | Asset test | Countable asset limit, single applicant | Placement precedence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult | 19 to 64 | 0 | 138 | No | No | No | $0.00 (no test) | 7 |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care | 19 to 64 | 0 | 100 | No | No | No | $0.00 (no test) | 6 |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | 0 to 18 | 148 | 235 | No | No | No | $0.00 (no test) | 4 |
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | 0 to 18 | 0 | 147 | No | No | No | $0.00 (no test) | 5 |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 0 to 120 (no upper age limit) | 0 | 200 | No | No | No | $0.00 (no test) | 3 |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | 0 to 120 (no upper age limit) | 0 | 100 | No | Yes | Yes | $2000.00 | 2 |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | 18 to 120 (no upper age limit) | 0 | 100 | Yes | No | Yes | $2000.00 | 1 |

## Further gate conditions by category

| Category | Conditions of the entry gate beyond the figures above |
|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult | Age 19 to 64, income at most 138 percent, no Medicare entitlement, not pregnant, no disability determination |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care | Age 19 to 64, income at most 100 percent, caretaker of a minor child, no Medicare entitlement |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | Age 0 to 18, income from 148 to 235 percent, no other creditable coverage |
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | Age 0 to 18, income at most 147 percent |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | Pregnancy verified, income at most 200 percent |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | A disability determination or age 65 or older, income at most 100 percent, countable assets at most $2000.00, no Medicare entitlement |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | Medicare Part A and Part B, income at most 100 percent, countable assets at most $2000.00 |

## Reading the schedule

- **Age.** The lowest and highest ages are completed years on the coverage start date. Where 120 is shown as the highest age, the category has no upper age limit.
- **Income floor and limit.** The limit is the highest whole percent of the federal poverty level the category admits. The floor is the whole percent below which the person belongs to a different category; a floor of 0 means the category has no floor. Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids is the only category with a floor, at 148 percent.
- **Asset test.** Countable household assets are tested at application and at renewal only where the asset test applies, and the limit shown is for a single applicant. Where no asset test applies the limit is shown as $0.00.
- **Placement precedence.** Where a person meets more than one category's entry gate, the category with the lower precedence number is the one placed. Prairie Ridge Dual Complete has the lowest number (1) and Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult the highest (7).

## Hypothetical readings

*The following are hypothetical illustrations built only from this schedule.*

- A child aged 7 on the coverage start date with household income at 147 percent is inside the Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid limit of 147 and below the Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids floor of 148. At 148 percent the same child is above the Children's Medicaid limit and at the CHIP Kids floor.
- An adult aged 40 with income at 95 percent who is the caretaker of a minor child, is not pregnant, and has neither a Medicare entitlement nor a disability determination meets both the Prairie Ridge Family Care gate (precedence 6) and the Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult gate (precedence 7); the lower number, Family Care, is placed.
- A person aged 70 with Medicare Part A and Part B, income at 90 percent and countable assets of $1500.00 meets the Prairie Ridge Dual Complete gate (precedence 1).
